tagline.en: ModelScopeT2V — an early, widely-used open text-to-video model from Alibaba's ali-vilab (non-commercial license).
tagline.zh: ModelScopeT2V——阿里 ali-vilab 推出的早期、广泛使用的开源文生视频模型(非商用许可)。

en: ModelScopeT2V is a text-to-video synthesis model from Alibaba's ali-vilab (DAMO Academy). You give it a text prompt and it generates a short video clip.

It's one of the early, widely-adopted open text-to-video models, built on a latent diffusion approach, and it's a common baseline and starting point for text-to-video work. The checkpoint is released under a CC-BY-NC-4.0 license.
In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline — give it a prompt and set fps and seed, and it writes out a video from the selected ModelScope checkpoint.
zh: ModelScopeT2V 是阿里 ali-vilab(达摩院)推出的文生视频合成模型。你给它一段文字提示,它便生成一段短视频。
它是早期、被广泛采用的开源文生视频模型之一,基于潜在扩散方法,常被用作文生视频工作的基线和起点。其 checkpoint 以 CC-BY-NC-4.0 许可发布。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 运行它——给它提示词,设置 fps 与 seed,它就会基于所选 ModelScope checkpoint 输出一段视频。

whenToUse.en: Use ModelScopeT2V for quick text-to-video prototyping or as a familiar baseline, especially for non-commercial research and experimentation.
whenToUse.zh: 用 ModelScopeT2V 做快速的文生视频原型,或作为熟悉的基线,尤其适合非商用的研究与实验。

notFor.en: The checkpoint carries a non-commercial (CC-BY-NC-4.0) license, so it isn't suited to commercial use. As an early model, its fidelity trails newer video generators. The checkpoint is downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 其 checkpoint 采用非商用(CC-BY-NC-4.0)许可,因此不适合商业用途。作为早期模型,其保真度不及更新的视频生成模型。Checkpoint 需单独下载。

en: Early, widely-used open text-to-video model from ali-vilab
Prompt, fps, and seed controls through the shared pipeline
zh: ali-vilab 推出的早期、广泛使用的开源文生视频模型
